title: Bar model template
subject: Mathematics
unit: Summer 1: Enlargement and similarity; ratio and proportion; rates
source: Seeded from mathematics/y9 lessons 60, 61 (Bar model template (printable, in the pupil PDF))
intro: To understand how to share an amount in a given ratio, including when one share or the difference is known

questions.q: Share 90 kg of dates in the ratio 1 : 2 : 3.
The ratio is 4 : 9 and the larger share is 54. Find the smaller share.
Red and blue counters are in the ratio 5 : 3. What fraction are blue?
⅖ of the trees in an orchard are olive trees and the rest are date palms. Write the ratio olive : date.
a : b = 1 : 2 and b : c = 3 : 4. Find a : b : c.
(a) Share £350 in the ratio 3 : 4. (b) Share 1.2 kg in the ratio 5 : 3. (c) In the ratio 2 : 3 : 5 the middle share is £27: find the total. (d) Two shares in the ratio 5 : 8 differ by 42: find both.
Three partners invest £5000, £3000 and £2000 and agree to share the profit in the ratio of their investments. The profit is £1800. Find each share.
A and B share money in the ratio 3 : 5, and B gets £40 more than A. A gives a quarter of his share as sadaqah. How much does he give?
questions.a: 2 parts = 40, 1 part = 20, A gets £60; a quarter is £15

questions.q: (a) In the ratio 4 : 5, what fraction of the whole is each part? (b) 5/8 of a field is wheat and the rest is barley: write wheat : barley. (c) x : y = 3 : 4 and y : z = 6 : 5: find x : y : z. (d) In the ratio 2 : 7, the first part is what fraction of the second?
Flour : sugar = 5 : 2 and sugar : butter = 3 : 4. A batch uses 300 g of flour. How much butter?
questions.a: 15 : 6 : 8; flour 15 parts = 300 g, so 1 part = 20 g and butter = 160 g

questions.q: Apples and pears are in the ratio 3 : 5. After 4 apples are eaten the ratio is 1 : 2. How many pears are there?
Share 40 in the ratio 3 : 5. The smaller share is:
Ratio 1 : 4 and the total is 75. The larger share?
Big question: how can partners share profit fairly?
questions.a: Agree a ratio at the start (for example, the ratio of what each invested) and share in it by finding the value of one part.

questions.q: In the ratio 1 : 4, the first part is what fraction of the whole?
Big question: how do ratios and fractions describe the same thing differently?
questions.a: A ratio compares parts with each other; a fraction compares one part with the whole (add the parts to get the denominator).
